summary: Recipe import photo copy fails for bonappetit.com (and any CDN without CORS): scrape succeeds, photo silently drops
evidence: attempt 01M3HVDMGE3XMDJWSPM0S8JA6M: status=success extractor=jsonld http_status=200, parsed.recipe.imageUrl=https://assets.bonappetit.com/photos/.../Chicken-and-Rice-With-Leeks-Salsa-Verde-01.jpg. curl -D- with Origin header: HTTP/2 200, content-type image/jpeg, content-length 534513, NO access-control-allow-origin. fetchRemoteImage() does fetch(url, {mode:'cors'}) in the browser, so the request is blocked before the body is read, catch returns null, PhotoField shows "Couldn't copy the photo from bonappetit.com". Size is under the 2MB cap, so CORS is the only failing condition.

summary: 3 randomizer corpus DB tests fail on a laptop whose local DB holds a big seeded corpus
evidence: randomizer.db.test.ts: 'expected [ wb-127960, wb-56140, ...(198) ] to include r-corpus-public-...'. The result window is 200 wide and this local DB has 4274 rows in recipe, 3695 of them seeded wb-* — so the recipe the test just inserted is not in the first 200. Fails with the image-copy work fully reverted from the query path: nothing in this change touches randomizer.ts. The tests assume a corpus small enough that a new public recipe lands in the window.

summary: local recipe_pending_image was missing source_url, which the migrations do define; 3 recipes-write DB tests failed and the create form's save path would have too
evidence: information_schema showed 5 columns (recipe_id, object_key, mime, alt, created_at). 1785700000000_create_recipe_pending_image adds source_url and 1788143104839_pending_image_bytes_only explicitly keeps it demoted to a log; kysely_migration shows both applied (2026-08-18 and 2026-09-02), so this DB applied a pre-amend version of a migration that was later edited in place. Repaired with 'alter table recipe_pending_image add column if not exists source_url text'; the 3 tests then passed. A fresh volume would not have had it.
